verdict: Paid ads went dark Sep 12; leads and pipeline need immediate attention.
narrative: All 20 leads and $303.50 in ad spend for this 28-day period were delivered before September 12 — paid activity has been at $0 for the 18 days since. With ads off, Google Business Profile actions also dropped 47% week-over-week and Instagram reach has effectively stopped, so organic visibility is fading alongside paid. Separately, 20 leads arrived this period but none converted to a booked appointment, which points to a gap in how incoming leads are being followed up — that is a pipeline issue worth addressing on your end as well. Ads are being reactivated and content activity is resuming this week; you should expect lead flow and organic actions to recover in the next reporting period.
